decisions.status: provisional-default (part 2 of 2: the flow; part 1, the retest model, is package engine-retest)
decisions.option: B: continue an interrupted session (< 24 h) as a NEW session flagged as a continuation; option A (true resume: same session id, clock and next item) is left for later
decisions.what_changed: (1) What a session records (run.ts #flags): done_<part> = true for each part that ended normally in this session (done_rt, done_matrix_series, done_spatial, done_memory, done_quant, done_coding_reading; not for a skipped part or one cut off by the end), completed = true for the end reason 'complete' (finished_early and hard_stop were already recorded), focus_session = true for a focus session, continuation = true (CONTINUATION_FLAG) for a continuation. All snake_case booleans, as the save schema's flags allow; at most 10 more flags, far under hb.valid_flags' 40. serverFlags() leaves these progress flags out (resume.ts isProgressFlag), so what the server receives is unchanged. (2) Detection (new src/session/resume.ts findUnfinished): the newest session of the save (orderSessions), with answers and no recorded end (completed / finished_early / hard_stop), started less than 24 h from now (|now - started_utc| < 24 h: a clock set back does not hide it), not a focus session, not a session of the online version (sig, or timed_tasks_only on it or on a session started in the same second), and with a part left to run. Parts finished = the union over its whole sitting (it may itself be a continuation) of the done_ flags and of what the answers show: a part also counts as finished when a later part has answers, or when every timed task of a part of timed tasks has its answer (so an older autosave of a session that reached its end, which has no completed flag, is not offered). A part whose skills were all skipped (skipped_<skill>) is finished and stays skipped. (3) The flow (SessionApp.svelte): the ready screen gets the offer when findUnfinished finds one in the base AND the session is one of this browser's autosaves AND the static version (backend null) AND the found saves come from one identifier AND they are to be added to (the 'Add my new session to ...' box ticked) AND this page did not ask for consent (askedConsent: the gate was not shown because the consent kept here is for the current terms). 'Continue your unfinished session' starts a new SessionRun with continues: { done, skipped } on the same base (the found saves, plus a loaded file), so the save keeps both. Its wall-clock start is now, or one second after the interrupted start when now is not a later second (resume.ts continuationStartMs), so it always comes right after the session it continues in time order, as the retest model requires. Begin still starts a fresh session. (4) The continuation run (run.ts RunConfig.continues): the plan is drawn as usual; then the parts done earlier are marked done and the skills skipped earlier are marked skipped (after the plan, so they stay on the checklist as Done / Skipped instead of 'Not in this version'); the first interstitial is the first part left, which starts from its beginning (its earlier answers stay in the interrupted session); the target (progress ring and CAT budgets) is the planned time of the parts it runs, so each part keeps its planned share; the break is offered only when the half-way boundary lies after its first part (never as its first screen). (5) Counts by sitting (new src/save/sittings.ts sittingIndex / sittingCount over engine/retest orderSessions + sessionSittings): Ready 'Add my new session to the n earlier sessions saved on this device', 'Your new session will be added to n earlier sessions', 'Loaded n earlier sessions', 'Loaded your backup with n earlier sessions'; Finished 'This profile combines k sessions' (earlier sittings plus this run's own sitting), 'This visit added no new answers. Your profile below comes from k earlier sessions' (a continuation that added nothing counts the session it continued), 'Your profile from k earlier sessions'; reveal/results.ts scoredSessions (share card 'Based on n sessions') counts a sitting once when any of its sessions scored, and devicePartSessions is counted by sitting too, so the pairing of online halves is unchanged. PRIMARY BUTTON (D27, one primary per screen): while the offer shows, 'Continue your unfinished session' is the primary button and Begin the secondary one. Why: the offer appears only right after a reload or crash within 24 h, so picking up is the likely intent; it also keeps the profile one session with no practice adjustment between the halves, while Begin re-runs parts already done and is then practice-adjusted against them. Begin stays next to it, and the line under the heading says what each does. SERVER VARIANT: no offer when backend is not null (recorded choice): the server's SQL rescore (rpc_rescore) numbers tests with row_number() over every session and does not read flags.continuation, so a served continuation would be practice-adjusted against the session it continues; serverFlags() does not send the flag either. CONSENT TERMS: no offer when this page showed the 18+ gate (no consent kept, or one for other terms), so a session started under other terms is not continued in the visit that asked again.

deviations: A continuation's target is the planned time of the parts it runs, not the 27.5-minute A15 target, so its ring reads 'n of about m min' for what is left; the hard stop is still 57 active minutes of the continuation itself (not of the sitting).
The 'Add my new session to the n earlier sessions saved on this device' box also governs the offer: unticked, there is no offer (a continuation is always added to the session it continues).
A focus session is recorded (focus_session) and is never offered for continuation: the save does not say which skills were chosen.
open_issues: Consent terms across visits: the offer is withheld in the visit that shows the gate again. A narrow case remains: terms change, a visit passes the new gate and leaves from the ready screen without answering, and a later visit within 24 h of the interrupted start then offers it (the consent kept is now current). Closing it needs a marker of the terms on the session (a flag can only be a number or boolean, e.g. a numeric date of the terms) or a time in the consent record (gate.ts, which keeps none by design).

Older autosaves (written before this change, within their 24 h): a finished focus session or a finished session whose reading passage was dropped (every passage seen) has no completed flag and can be offered as unfinished; Begin is still there. Only autosaves less than a day old at deploy time are affected.

The Finished summary line ('You answered n questions and completed m timed tasks in about k minutes') counts this visit only, not the whole sitting; the profile and every session count use the sitting.
The server variant offers nothing. Before it does, the served SQL rescore must count sittings (engine-retest open issue) and serverFlags would have to send continuation.

The interrupted part's earlier answers stay in the interrupted session and count (same sitting, no practice adjustment); the part is run again from its start with new items (seen families excluded), so the sitting can hold, for example, two digit-span-forward blocks.
True resume (option A) is not done.
